title: Taste: My Life Through Food by Stanley Tucci
description:
This week, Novels & Nibbles slips off the path of fiction and into something more delicious… Stanley Tucci’s memoire, served with wit, warmth, and impeccable flavor. Tucci invites us to the table of his life shaped by a gloriously food-obsessed Italian-American childhood, a rich career in film, courses of personal struggle, and a few recipes along the way. He reminds us that a life well lived is best told at the table with a story, a memory, and a wonderful meal because food is not just sustenance… it’s a way of loving and identity.

There is a certain romance to a pot that has been murmuring all morning and our Tucci Ragu is perfecto. Beef stew meat and country-style short ribs, coaxed slowly into tenderness the proper way, with crushed plum tomatoes melting into garlic and onion, a generous pour of red wine doing its quiet, essential work. Fresh basil and oregano (from our herb garden) arrive not with fanfare, but finish with confidence, 

Come hungry. Sit down. Stay awhile. Maybe pour another glass of wine while you’re at it.
